procedure_metadata.title: Google Drive Takeout Archive Inventory and Inspection Procedure
procedure_metadata.purpose: Execute via MetaProcedure JS Runner to safely inspect a Google Drive Takeout archive via the deployed Apps Script doPost bridge, record complete metadata and entry enumeration without mutating the source archive, persist a distinct inspection report to Google Drive, and record a verified local execution receipt.

definitions.definition: The repository-grounded Node.js script (untrusted AI/meta-procedure/Procedures/JS Runner/js-runner.js) that parses JSON files, discovers top-level or nested 'script' string properties, and executes them in an isolated vm context.

The deployed Google Apps Script doPost web endpoint (https://script.google.com/macros/s/AKfycbxz7tkba4wl-wWzDn90iuh0us2l2EUD3AYV9HyVJckETKGjhPKFthnqPyYmcOPOk_g5FA/exec) backed by ChatMachines/GeminiSupervisor/Code.gs that evaluates an arbitrary JavaScript function string against arguments in Google Workspace runtime.
The operational invariant that the target archive file in Google Drive is strictly read-only and never overwritten, truncated, or renamed.
distinguished_from: Drive report creation, which creates a new separate file

instructions.primary_instruction: Execute the Drive Takeout archive inspection by running the procedure's script property through MetaProcedure JS Runner.

operations.object: target drive file id and run id
operations.completion_condition: Parameters validated and bound to execution context
Payload formatted as {sourcecode: string, arguments: object}

operations.object: HTTP POST to Apps Script endpoint
operations.completion_condition: HTTP 200 received with JSON payload containing status, driveFileId, and driveFileUrl

operations.object: remote report creation and source archive immutability
operations.completion_condition: Assert driveFileId !== sourceFileId, archiveModified === false, and status in ['ENUMERATED', 'METADATA_ONLY']
Receipt file written to workspace filesystem and logged to stdout

composition_relations.reason: Verified result must be written to disk

conditional_branches.condition: Utilities.unzip fails due to archive size or memory limit in Apps Script
conditional_branches.instruction: Catch exception inside Apps Script, record error message, populate status as METADATA_ONLY, write inspection report containing file metadata, and return report file ID and URL.
conditional_branches.otherwise: Enumerate entries, populate status as ENUMERATED, write full inspection report, and return report file ID and URL.

scope: Inspect target Google Drive file identified by input.drive_file_id.
Create exactly one new inspection report file in Google Drive under name takeout-archive-inspection-<runId>.json.
Write local result file to untrusted AI/meta-procedure/Procedures/DriveTakeoutInventory/latest-result.json.
prohibited: Do not modify, overwrite, delete, or rename the source archive file in Google Drive.
Do not invent new GitHub Actions YAML workflow files.
Do not invent arbitrary hardcoded archive size caps; handle memory limits adaptively via try/catch.
Do not treat HTTP 200 alone as proof of task completion without verifying report file ID and URL.
required: Execute via MetaProcedure JS Runner consuming the 'script' property.
Preserve exact Apps Script doPost payload contract ({sourcecode, arguments}).
Assert archiveModified === false in returned receipt.
Verify driveFileId !== sourceFileId before reporting completion.
information: Ground all endpoint URLs and bridge formats in ChatMachines/GeminiSupervisor/Code.gs and .github/workflows/test-appscript-endpoint.yml.

invariants.statement: The source Takeout archive file remains untouched and unmutated throughout execution.
invariants.violation_response: Immediate procedure abort and failure reporting

invariants.statement: Every reported completion is evidenced by an authoritative Drive file ID, URL, and local receipt file.
invariants.violation_evidence: driveFileId is null or latest-result.json does not exist

sources.subject: AI-NLEP specification and evaluation standards
sources.retrieval_rule: Read and conform to all required semantic sections.

sources.retrieval_rule: Adhere to doPost eval contract taking {sourcecode, arguments}.

authorities.conflict_policy: Authoritative repository implementation files override assistant assumptions.

inference_and_discretion_policy.default_policy: Apply rules literally without silent assumptions.

dispositions.literal: Dispatch exact payload to Apps Script endpoint.
dispositions.retrieve: Inspect remote Drive file metadata via DriveApp.
dispositions.block: Block if endpoint returns HTTP error or DriveApp cannot find file.

decision_rules.when: Archive is too large to unzip in Apps Script
decision_rules.rule: Record METADATA_ONLY and generate inspection report.

prohibited_inferences: Do not infer that HTTP status 200 guarantees Drive report existence.
Do not infer that absence of decompression error implies empty archive.

state_variables.name: target_file_id
state_variables.purpose: Identifies the Google Drive archive to inspect

state_variables.name: dispatch_status
state_variables.purpose: Tracks HTTP communication with Apps Script

state_variables.name: report_file_id
state_variables.purpose: Holds the created Drive inspection report file ID

update_rules.update_rule: Set to success on HTTP 200; error otherwise.
Set to persisted when writeFileSync succeeds.

persistence_rules: Persist final execution receipt to untrusted AI/meta-procedure/Procedures/DriveTakeoutInventory/latest-result.json.
state_reconstruction_prohibitions: Do not reconstruct state from prior executions.

states.meaning: POST sent to Apps Script endpoint
Execution failed due to unrecoverable error

transitions.condition: HTTP 200 with valid Drive file locators

retry_rules.rule: Retry up to 2 times with 1000ms delay on network/5xx error

principles: VP1: Verify literal procedural requirements without proxy substitution.
VP2: Require re-findable locators for all created external artifacts.
VP3: Maintain clear distinction between action occurrence and external effect.
VP4: Source archive immutability must be strictly established.

checks.on_fail: Fail execution and log constraint breach

checks.claim: Inspection report exists in Google Drive
checks.evidence_required: result.driveFileId non-empty string && result.driveFileUrl valid string
checks.on_fail: Mark effect unverified and fail step

checks.claim: Execution receipt is persisted to disk
checks.pass_condition: File exists on runner disk with matching runId

verification_model.ground_truth_policy: Live receipts from Apps Script response and runner filesystem constitute ground truth.
verification_model.self_assertion_policy: Self-assertion is never sufficient without returned Drive locators and persisted receipt.
verification_model.action_effect_distinction: Node.js dispatch is action occurrence; Google Drive file creation is external effect.

known_failure_modes.name: Apps Script in-memory decompression quota exceeded
known_failure_modes.cause: Utilities.unzip throws exception when archive exceeds internal memory limits
known_failure_modes.prevention: Wrap unzip in try/catch in Apps Script sourcecode
known_failure_modes.detection: Catch block in sourcecode intercepts error and marks status METADATA_ONLY
known_failure_modes.recovery: Create Drive report containing full file metadata, record error diagnostic, and proceed

known_failure_modes.name: Network timeout or HTTP 5xx from Apps Script endpoint
known_failure_modes.cause: Transient endpoint downtime or network blip
known_failure_modes.prevention: Timeout signal and retry loop in Node.js fetch
known_failure_modes.recovery: Retry dispatch up to 2 times before failing

known_failure_modes.name: DriveApp cannot locate target file ID
known_failure_modes.cause: Target file ID does not exist or lacks read permission
known_failure_modes.prevention: Validate fileId format prior to dispatch
known_failure_modes.detection: Apps Script catch block reports File not found

error_model.unknown_error_policy: Capture verbatim error message and stack, record in latest-result.json, and terminate with exitCode 1.

constraints: Examples are illustrative and do not alter governing rules.

context_policy.include_when: Information is required to resolve DriveApp, JS Runner, or endpoint parameters.
context_policy.exclude_when: Redundant workflow files or unneeded HTTP wrappers.
context_policy.retrieve_on_demand_when: File blobs are fetched only within Apps Script runtime.
context_policy.locality_rule: Keep endpoint URL and payload schema co-located in script.
context_policy.signal_density_rule: Preserve complete executable script without placeholders.

return_contract.omission_policy: No required return fields may be omitted.

procedure_execution_semantics.governing_rule: A prescribed operation is satisfied by occurrence of that operation in current execution, verified by local receipt and remote locators.
authorized_nonexecution: Unzipping entries may be skipped if Utilities.unzip throws, falling back to METADATA_ONLY report.
invalid_completion_proxies: Preexisting latest-result.json from an earlier run.
procedure_execution_semantics.completion_claim_rule: Completion requires successful OP1-OP5 execution with verified driveFileId and persisted local receipt.

complete_when: Remote inspection executed via Apps Script bridge.
Drive inspection report created and locators verified (driveFileId !== sourceFileId).
incomplete_when: Any of OP1-OP5 has not finished.
blocked_when: Apps Script endpoint unreachable or source file inaccessible.
failed_when: Unrecoverable HTTP or script error occurs.
must_not_claim_complete_when: latest-result.json is not written to disk.

Grounding anchored in Code.gs, js-runner.js, and test-appscript-endpoint.yml.
Inference policy explicitly assigns dispositions and prohibits silent defaults.
Precedence rules establish repository interfaces as governing.
No conflicting rules; source immutability consistent throughout.
Operations atomized into discrete steps OP1-OP5.
Composition relations preserve execution sequence and dependencies.
State model defines all tracking variables with sources and update rules.
Transition model defines states, conditions, retries, and terminal guards.
Structural separation divides instructions, state, constraints, and script.
Examples kept non-governing and minimal.
Context co-located directly in execution payload without redundant bloat.
Interfaces match real repo mechanisms: Node vm runner + Apps Script eval bridge.
Constraints proportioned to prevent corruption while permitting adaptive unzip handling.
Observability enforced via Drive file locators and local filesystem receipts.
Semantic projection categorizes all procedural elements into canonical classes.
Return contract explicitly specifies required response schema.
